capabilities.title: Episodic memory store: each agent session records facts, decisions, and artifacts with timestamps
capabilities.sourceEvidence: agentmemory core: episodic event log with session boundaries

capabilities.title: Semantic similarity retrieval over past agent sessions using embedding vectors
capabilities.sourceEvidence: agentmemory retrieval: vector similarity search over episodic store
capabilities.reason: Embedding every personal session would create a second durable representation of sensitive operator text and may require an external embedding provider. Nexus keeps transparent keyword-plus-recency retrieval until an explicit encrypted vector lifecycle exists.

capabilities.title: Recency-weighted memory retrieval: recent memories ranked higher by default
capabilities.sourceEvidence: agentmemory recency decay formula in retrieval scorer
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Half-life decay in scoreEpisodicRelevance; keyword overlap + recency blend.

capabilities.title: Benchmark harness comparing memory strategies across diverse agent workloads
capabilities.sourceEvidence: agentmemory benchmark suite: episodic vs semantic vs hybrid retrieval comparison
capabilities.reason: A deterministic harness now compares recency-only, keyword-only, and hybrid retrieval across five agent workloads and asserts the expected top memory for every hybrid case.

capabilities.title: Deduplication of repeated facts across sessions to prevent memory bloat
